messages:
Maria G.: Heads-up — OrionCloud marketplace just pushed a staggered provisioning update for our EU Dedicated commit. 3 racks were booked under ORD-94832 but the manifest shows 2 delivered + 1 in RMA. This will affect our region capacity target for next week. @Aj can you triage?
Aj Patel: Ack. Pinged the Orion account rep and asked for a full manifest + RMA ETA. Also checking whether they can hot-swap equivalent SKUs from nearby warehouse. ORD-94832, SKU-GPU-A10x12.
Liam O'Connor: If RMA > 7 days we should plan fallback to cloud provider burst or re-route some tenants to US-west. Need to know which customer commits this impacts (percent of reserved throughput).
Nina Chen: I have two customers on the EU commit: ACME (50% of weekly reserved qps) and BrightHealth (30%). Both have go-lives next Wed and will expect SLA. We need a mitigation plan before Monday standup.
Kevin Ramos: Quick ask — can we split the commit? Move ACME to a partial burst on hosted and keep BrightHealth on the remaining capacity? That buys us time while Orion resolves RMA.
orioncloud-bot: Update: RMA case #RC-7721 created. ETA: diagnostic 48-72h, replacement availability depends on regional stock.
Aj Patel: Orion said replacement is prioritized but not guaranteed within 72h. They offered a partial ship from FR warehouse (1 rack) but need confirmation by EOD. I proposed shipping same-day if we sign a temporary credit request.
Maria G.: Two immediate asks: 1) @Liam, prepare a routing plan (A: burst to hosted, B: cross-region reroute) with estimated cost delta by EOD. 2) @Kevin, draft customer comms options (A: defer non-critical jobs, B: temporary hosted burst) and a compensatory credit proposal.
Liam O'Connor: On it. Initial numbers: hosted burst for ACME (~50% qps) ~ +18% token cost, cross-region reroute adds latency ~40-60ms p90. I'll attach a short table in the follow-up.
Kevin Ramos: Drafting comms. Proposed wording: short apology, ETA estimate, mitigation steps, and option to accept temporary hosted burst (with 20% credit for impacted hours). Thoughts?
Aj Patel: Also flagged to procurement: if Orion can’t meet lead time, we should accelerate alternate partner quotes (ByteCloud / OrbitRack). Asked for price/lead estimates.
Maria G.: Good. Can we also confirm whether the Dedicated commit SLA triggers any service credits here? If so, we should align compensation language with legal. @Nina loop in legal?
Nina Chen: Looping Legal now. Suggest a soft commitment in customer note: we will prioritize their workload and offer credit if we breach committed throughput. Legal to confirm exact phrasing.
orioncloud-bot: Update: FR warehouse tentatively can ship 1 rack today if we accept temporary credit holdback. RMA diagnostic scheduled in 36h.
Aj Patel: Decision point: accept partial FR ship (1 rack) + hosted burst for remaining demand, or demand full replacement and move customers to hosted until RMA completes. I recommend partial ship + hosted burst — lower customer impact.
Maria G.: Agree partial ship + hosted burst. Kevin, finalize the comms with the 20% credit and host-burst option. Liam, finalize cost/latency tradeoffs. Aj, lock the FR ship and confirm tracking number. Nina, send to Legal.
Kevin Ramos: Will send comms draft in 15m. Short, actionable, includes opt-in for temporary hosted burst.
Liam O'Connor: Finalizing numbers now. Cost delta + expected p90 latency per route included.
Aj Patel: FR ship locked; tracking ETA 48h. RMA still pending but in progress. Sending manifest to Maria now: `MAN-ORD-94832-FR-1`.
Maria G.: Thanks team. After comms goes out I'll schedule an immediate sync with Orion partner ops and our SRE on Monday to confirm cutover steps. :thumbsup:
Nina Chen: Legal replied — "approve customer notice with provisional credit language; finalize numbers before send."
Kevin Ramos: Sent comms to ACME & BrightHealth (cc: Legal). Template included an opt-in button for hosted burst.
Liam O'Connor: Updated internal on-call routing; if latency breaches >100ms we auto-failover to US-west.
Maria G.: Closing loop — keep here for updates. If Orion changes RMA ETA we re-open routing. Thanks all. :heart:
